title: Get the potholes on your blocks fixed

median_days_to_close.note: Median waits leave out requests the city closed in bulk on Feb 2 to 4, 2026.

what_happened: Clinton has 128 unresolved pothole requests at 72 locations.
71 of 99 open requests are more than a year old (72%). Citywide: 3,607 of 4,995 (72%).
Oldest unresolved request: E 19TH ST & 13TH AVE, filed 2021-03-02, status UNFUNDED.
Most reported location: 12TH AVE & E 19TH ST, 6 unresolved requests, oldest filed 2023-07-08.
why_it_matters: When the city closes a pothole request in Clinton, the median wait is 179 days. Across Oakland it is 66 days.

paths.title: Report and push the city
paths.who: Anyone. You can do this alone.
paths.legal_note: The city asks residents to report non-emergency issues online through OAK 311.

steps.text: Walk your blocks with the list below. An open request is not proof the hole is still there; some streets were repaved after the report.
For each hole that is still there, add a photo and a note to the existing request, or file a new one. Give the request number from our list.
Send the list to your council office and to OakDOT and ask for a repair date. Use the email we draft for you; it goes from your own account. Transparent City sends nothing.
Speak at the City Council's Public Works and Transportation Committee with the same numbers.
Follow the list. When report-back opens, we will tell you when a request on it changes status.

cost_time.label: Cost
cost_time.source: The City of Oakland OAK 311 page lists no fee for reporting (checked 2026-11-21).

cost_time.label: Time
cost_time.value: One walk of your blocks, then a few minutes per report
cost_time.source: Our estimate, not a measured figure.

who_fixes.text: Report potholes to OAK 311. The city reviews each request, gives it a tracking number and assigns it to a work group.

rules.unverified_note: We could not find a City of Oakland page that says residents may fill potholes themselves. Until the city publishes one, this page offers one path: report the holes and push the city to fix them.

statements.text: Report non-emergency street problems online or in the OAK 311 app. For urgent problems, dial 311 or (510) 615-5566.
Anyone blocking a traffic lane, street parking, curb or sidewalk needs an Obstruction Permit from OakDOT first. An approved Traffic Control Plan may also be required.

background.text: In 2016 a Public Works spokesperson told KTVU it is illegal for residents to fill potholes. That is a news report, not a city rules page.

source.title: Oakland public works discourage residents from filling potholes themselves

4. 1999 10TH AVE: requests 1204113, 1403745, 1578690, 1628663, first reported 2022-04-29
5. 8TH AV & FOOTHILL BLVD: requests 1398406, 1417457, 1606180, 1608009, first reported 2024-04-09
6. 1720 10TH AVE: requests 1402684, 1402687, 1462044, 1462047, first reported 2024-04-23
7. 1640 6TH AVE: requests 1473624, 1477753, 1485270, 1490147, first reported 2024-12-06
